name: Lambs Book Of Life
overview: The Lamb's Book of Life is depicted in Scripture as a divine record maintained by God, in which the names of the righteous are written and preserved. Those who fear the Lord and remain faithful are acknowledged in this book, as seen in Malachi where a book of remembrance is kept for them, and in Luke where believers rejoice that their names are written in heaven. Conversely, those who sin against God risk being blotted out from this book, as Moses intercedes in Exodus, and the psalmist prays for the removal of the wicked from the book of the living. Ultimately, the book signifies God's sovereign knowledge and judgment, assuring deliverance for those found written within it, as Daniel affirms during times of great tribulation.
